correctness.rationale: For unit-positive cross edges and strictly positive-gain earliest-created tie-breaking, the initial monochromatic run r creates r singletons; the first opposite-color arrival joins the earliest singleton, and thereafter that mixed coalition remains earliest and gives a maximizing positive gain to every arrival. Hence exactly r-1 early vertices remain stranded and Q=1-(r-1)/a (or symmetric). Hypergeometric run probabilities sum to one; separator symmetry proves mean 1-1/(a+1)-1/(b+1)+2/(a+b); strict convexity yields star minima and balanced maxima for fixed N; extreme-order statistics give Beta(a,1) as the other part grows, and bounded deficit gives the both-growing limit. Independently simulated direct greedy choices on all side-arrival words in tested small parts and verified rational means; proof covers every positive a,b.
residual_risks: Formula depends on earliest-created coalition positive-gain tie-break; another tie-break or weighted network can fail.
